title: fix(plugin-list): a list view locked by lockedBy alone shows its lock indicator
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbProKrb75xotDgo6ojkBgdz)_

Fixes #29009

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:列表视图的 `sharing` 只写了 `lockedBy`、没写 `type` 时,工具栏现在会显示锁定标记「Locked by 用户」,旁边的类型标签按 spec 默认值显示为「Shared view」。写了 `type` 的视图显示不变;`sharing` 里两个键都没写时什么都不显示。
- **为什么改**:spec 把 `type` 默认为 `collaborative`,但下发的视图是作者原文、不带默认值,而工具栏只在 `type` 存在时才画这个标记,所以「只写 lockedBy」的已锁定视图对其他人看不出被锁。现在锁定标记只看 `lockedBy`,以后 #29037 退役 `personal` 或 `type` 也不会再把它藏掉。
- **风险与回滚**:只改工具栏一个只读标记的显示条件,没有新的元数据键、选项或文案;默认类型从 spec 的 `ViewSharingSchema` 读取,不在 ui 里重抄。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:`ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` 里 `hasSharingIndicator` 和 `SPEC_DEFAULT_SHARING_TYPE`,以及 sharing 标记块与分隔线的 `hasLeftSideItems`;`ListView.test.tsx` 的 `sharing spec format — additional`。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.test.tsx`,应 158/158 通过,其中「shows the lock from `sharing.lockedBy` with no `type`」一条。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **The lock keys on `lockedBy`, not on `type`.** The toolbar's read-only sharing indicator rendered only under `schema.sharing?.type`, so a view authored as `sharing: { lockedBy: 'admin@objectos.ai' }` showed no lock at all. It now renders when `sharing` declares a `type` or a `lockedBy` (`hasSharingIndicator`), and the lock part depends on `lockedBy` alone. The toolbar separator's `hasLeftSideItems` reads the same predicate, so the separator follows the indicator.
- **An absent `type` shows the spec's default type label.** The served view carries the authored body, and nothing on the render path parses it, so `type` arrives absent. The indicator reads the default from the contract, `ViewSharingSchema.parse({}).type` (today `collaborative`, shown as "Shared view"), once at module load, the same way `ListView` already reads the pagination page size from `PaginationConfigSchema`. Why the default and not "no badge": per the spec the view IS collaborative, and a view that writes `type: 'collaborative'` with the same lock already shows "Shared view · Locked by USER", so the two spellings of one contract value now render the same. If #29037 later retires `type`, this read stops compiling, which points the author at this spot.
- **Unchanged.** A view with `type` set renders exactly as before; a `sharing` block with neither key, and a view with no `sharing`, show nothing; the copy (`list.sharingLockedBy`, `list.sharingPersonal`, `list.sharingCollaborative`) is untouched. No spec edit.

## Tests

- `ListView.test.tsx`, `sharing spec format — additional`:
  - The card's reproduction, three rows: `sharing: { lockedBy: 'admin@objectos.ai' }` with no `type`, with `type: 'collaborative'`, and with `type: 'personal'`. Each shows "Locked by admin@objectos.ai" and the title `TYPE_LABEL · Locked by admin@objectos.ai`.
  - `sharing: {}` (neither key) shows no indicator and no lock.

## Acceptance notes

- Sequencing with #29037 (open, `domain:spec`): that card retires the `personal` value and may retire `type` and the type label. This PR makes the lock independent of `type`, so the lock survives either outcome; the type label is the part #29037 owns.
- Serial note: open PRs #29273 and #29266 also edit `ListView.tsx`. Neither had landed when this branch merged `origin/main` `f2bf2938`. This diff touches the `@objectstack/spec/ui` import line, one module-level block after `DEFAULT_LIST_DISPLAY_PAGE_SIZE`, the sharing block and the separator's `hasLeftSideItems` line; none of their hunks overlaps those lines.
- Not measured in a real browser: the change is one render condition in `ListView`, and the tests render the real component.

The failing case is "shows the lock from `sharing.lockedBy` with no `type` (the spec default)". Restored: blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
